fixed.item: Adoption breakage 14 (pets cross-domain report 2): a careful or quiet-mode robot woke and startled every sleeping pet within one cell
fixed.how: traverse._proximity: a sleeping pet within one cell wakes and is startled only when the footfalls at the pace actually walked reach common.PET_WAKE_DB = 33 dB at 1 m (body.noise_db, so quiet mode's -4 dB counts; the pets domain's STARTLE_RESTING_DB, so both models agree: normal 36 wakes, careful 30 and quiet normal 32 do not); along a core approach / walk_to the pets domain decides when it is loaded (its _startle_along), so nothing is startled twice (common.pets_domain_loaded, traverse.PETS_OWN_STARTLE)
fixed.test: tests/test_navigation_robot.py TestMarginsAndSocial.test_sleeping_dog_woken_by_footfalls_not_by_a_careful_or_quiet_pass (replaces test_sleeping_dog_startled_even_careful, which pinned the defect)

fixed.item: Adoption breakage 20 (D3 triage): T-0383801c7466a3-01 and T-089c40fb507289-01 failed under forced realistic + geometric (the reference stepped on a cord / wet patch it never saw; the cord lies behind a cabinet from the start corner, and a look around surveys 3-29 floor cells)
fixed.how: new reference skill navigation_robot.move_watching (skills.py): room camera = one move with avoid (unchanged own-mode behaviour); geometric camera = two-cell legs toward the doorway, aiming the head at the end of each leg before planning it with the robot's own route filter (no privileged knowledge). Both references use it. Forced realistic + geometric: 12/12 specs of navigation_robot__examples.json pass (was 10/12)
fixed.test: tests/test_navigation_robot.py TestPhase1Stabilise.test_move_watching_sees_the_floor_before_each_leg; python -m house_sim --check tasks/authored/navigation_robot__examples.json --perception realistic --camera geometric: 12 passed

fixed.item: Review H10 / P2-cond F-C2: descending winder stairs at normal speed was a fall by rule (stairs.py:128), so 12 reference runs fell on held-out seeds 501/502 (8 specs)
fixed.how: stairs.plan: at a walking pace the robot keeps to the walk line (winder treads as deep as straight ones there) while a hand is on the rail and the treads are lit; without the rail (both hands full, broken rail, known loose rail), in poor light, or fast, a heel comes off a narrow inner end; careful is always fine; climbing winders is not a hazard. Verified: T-92f2736b7f949c-01 and T-89d7a649052266-01 (admin_inventory) pass on seeds 501 and 502

fixed.item: Review M1 'Derived floor hazards' / P3-side L5: hazards.derived wrote fragile rings and rug_slip areas from inspect-tier fields (fragile, topple_prone, non_slip_pad), so twins differing only in a hidden value showed different hazard maps at the first glance and planned different routes
fixed.how: hazards.knows_margin / unknown_margins: under realistic perception a fragile ring (inputs fragile, topple_prone; wall_decor for wall-hung decor) and a rug_slip area (non_slip_pad, anchored) exist for the robot only once it knows a true input at its tier. The observer scrubs unknown ones from obs.grid.hazards / room.floor_hazards; traverse.hide_unperceived_margins (generalising the mirror stash) keeps them out of every core motion's planning, robot field _nav_plan_unknown keeps the path_blocked hook from adding them back, traverse.plan_path does the same for go_to social walks and lead, and lead's spoken warnings leave out an unknown rug_slip. Consequences are unchanged (truth). Oracle mode unchanged

T-9615ae9f7570b4-01 (navigation_robot__perception): wrong plan 'measures the width once at mid height' now reads the tape's label first (it used add_case without reading, which is refused after the add_case fix, so it no longer performed its named mistake); spec passes 5/5 in own mode and with the geometric camera

requests.request: Geometric camera has no memory of floor hazards it saw: Realism.route_hazards, obs.grid.hazards and cleaning's wet_floor_seen veto use only this step's frames (camera.seen_floor), so a wet patch looked at one step is walked through the next. Repro: build tasks/authored/navigation_robot__examples.json T-089c40fb507289-01 seed 41 with perception realistic, camera geometric; plan walk_to [3,8]; look [3,5]; walk_to [3,6] avoid [wet]; look [3,3]; walk_to [3,4] avoid [wet] -> nav.terrain.wet_cells_walked 1 (it crossed the wet cell [3,5] it had looked at). Suggested: a per-episode floor map of what the frames surveyed (cell -> last seen hazard kinds, invalidated when seen again or after a time), used by route planning and the hazard list

Core move / walk_to plan once from the frames at the start of the step; with the geometric camera a hazard of an avoided kind that comes into view during the walk is stepped on (a real robot's local planner re-plans or stops). Repro: tests/test_navigation_robot.py TestPhase1Stabilise.screened_cables(): env(pos=(1,4), perception='realistic', camera='geometric'), move kitchen avoid=['cord'] -> nav.contacts.cords 1. Suggested: during the motion, when a frame shows a source of an avoided kind on the remaining path, stop short and note it (cut the motion record) or re-plan from there. navigation_robot.move_watching is the reference-side workaround meanwhile
